cpl.author: Yannis Anthymidis
cpl.name: HyperGSD Ticklers
cpl.title: yan/hypergsd-ticklers
cpl.readme:
A ''HyperGSD tickler'' is a reminder you can attach to a HyperGSD action. You pick a date for it. When the date arrives, an alert appears with a link to the action. You can also set the tickler to repeat every //n// days.

! The alert banner

When a tickler is due today, or its date has passed, a banner appears. From the banner you can complete the action, defer it to a later date, or close the banner.

Completing or deferring also closes the banner. If you just close the banner, it comes back while the tickler still needs attention. A tickler without a repeat interval reminds you once a day until you handle it. A repeating tickler comes back as an alert on its next due date.

! The tickler check

The check runs when the wiki loads, every hour at <samp>hh:00</samp>, and at local midnight. It only runs in an open browser. There is no timer if TiddlyWiki is run on a server.

If the wiki was closed on a due date, the banner will appear again the next time that you open the wiki.

! Repeating ticklers

A repeating tickler comes back on every due date. The reminder comes even when the action is marked as Complete. Completing an action does not stop the reminder, but the action stays complete.

Each new due date is counted from the one before it, never from the day you open the wiki. A tickler that repeats every 7 days from a Monday is always due on a Monday. If the wiki was closed across one or more due dates, those are skipped. The tickler jumps straight to its next due date.

! The dashboard

The [[GSD/Ticklers]] dashboard lists ticklers in three sections:

* //Ticklers requiring action//: due today or overdue, and not yet complete
* //Upcoming ticklers//: dated in the future (a completed repeating tickler waits here between due dates)
* //Old ticklers//: complete, with a date in the past (behind a show/hide toggle)

! Settings

You can switch the date-shift buttons (<kbd>+d</kbd>, <kbd>+w</kbd>, etc) on or off in Settings → HyperGSD → [[Ticklers|$:/plugins/yan/hypergsd-ticklers/ui/control-panel/ticklers]]. The buttons beside the tickler date and the buttons on the banner are set separately.

! Fields

|Field |Meaning |h
|`gsd_tickler_date` |When the tickler fires, as a TiddlyWiki UTC date string at midnight |
|`gsd_tickler_date_history` |Every date the tickler has had, oldest first. The last entry is the current date. The plugin does not display this list anywhere. |
|`gsd_tickler_repeat_days` |How many days between repeats. Zero or empty means the tickler does not repeat. It alerts only on its due date. |

! Shift buttons

Each shift button is a small tiddler.

* Tag a button with <<tag $:/tags/hypergsd/Ticklers/Shift>> to show it beside the tickler date.
* Tag a button with <<tag $:/tags/hypergsd/Ticklers/Alert>> to show it on the alert banner.

The buttons are rendered by the shared `$hgsd.tickler-shift` widget. A button tiddler carries these fields:

|Field |Meaning |h
|`days` |Whole days to move the date by. Minus values bring the date forward. |
|`label` |Button text. |
|`tooltip` |Button tooltip, plain text or a `<<lingo>>` key. |
|`class` |Optional CSS class for the button. |

The widget can also be used on its own, with explicit parameters:

|Parameter |Meaning |h
|`target-tiddler` |The tiddler whose `gsd_tickler_date` is written. |
|`base-date` |The date the shift starts from. The panel passes the stored date, the banner passes now. |
|`days` |Whole days to move the date by. |
|`label` |Button text. |
|`tooltip` |Button tooltip, plain text or a `<<lingo>>` key (see `lingo-base`). |
|`class` |Optional CSS class for the button. |
|`after-shift-actions` |Optional wikitext actions to run after the date is written. The banner uses this to close itself. |
|`lingo-base` |Base title for `<<lingo>>` keys. Defaults to the shared Sections namespace. |

As with a change of date through the widget, every shift is also recorded on the `gsd_tickler_date_history`.

---

Idea based on the [[GSD5 ticklers extension|https://gitlab.com/gsd5-tiddlywiki/gsd5-ticklers]] by Roma Hicks, reworked from scratch for HyperGSD.
